name: AdvancedMD vs SimplePractice
title: AdvancedMD vs SimplePractice: EHR Comparison for Behavioral Health
description: Compare AdvancedMD and SimplePractice for mental health practices. See differences in pricing, features, e-prescribing, and target audiences.

summary.bottom_line: AdvancedMD is a modular enterprise platform with mental health bundles and full RCM services, while SimplePractice is an all-in-one solution designed for smaller mental health practices. Choose AdvancedMD for multi-specialty practices needing modular flexibility and RCM services; choose SimplePractice for solo/small mental health practices wanting simplicity and transparent pricing.

sections.heading: AdvancedMD vs SimplePractice: Overview
sections.content: AdvancedMD and SimplePractice serve different segments of the mental health market. AdvancedMD is a comprehensive cloud EHR platform founded in 1999 that serves multi-specialty practices including behavioral health, offering modular pricing and full revenue cycle management services. SimplePractice is designed specifically for solo and small mental health practices with an intuitive all-in-one approach. AdvancedMD offers mental health bundles starting at $130/month (Now self-service) while SimplePractice starts at $49/month with transparent tier-based pricing.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: SimplePractice has simple, public pricing: Starter ($49), Essential ($79), Plus ($99) per month. AdvancedMD is more complex with mental health bundles from $130/month (self-service Now option) to $399/month for complete bundles, plus optional per-encounter pricing ($0.87-$2.17/claim). AdvancedMD often requires multi-year contracts while SimplePractice is month-to-month. For small practices, SimplePractice is more accessible. AdvancedMD's value increases for larger practices that benefit from full RCM services (4-8% of collections).

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: AdvancedMD's key advantages are full RCM services (outsourced billing at 4-8% of collections), modular pricing flexibility, and ONC certification. SimplePractice's strengths are ease of use, transparent pricing, and strong mental health focus. Both have e-prescribing (AdvancedMD native, SimplePractice $49/mo add-on), telehealth, AI documentation, and mobile apps. AdvancedMD is better for practices wanting professional billing services; SimplePractice is better for practices handling billing in-house.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on your practice size and billing needs:

recommendations.when: You're a mid-size or growing practice wanting professional RCM services, need modular pricing flexibility, or operate multi-specialty with behavioral health
You're a solo therapist or small practice, want simple transparent pricing, prefer month-to-month flexibility, or handle your own billing
You want outsourced billing at 4-8% of collections rather than managing claims yourself

faqs.q: Is AdvancedMD overkill for a solo therapist?
faqs.a: Often yes. AdvancedMD's mental health bundles start at $130/month vs. SimplePractice at $49/month. AdvancedMD's value is in RCM services and modular enterprise features that solo practices typically don't need. SimplePractice is a better fit for most solo therapists.

faqs.q: Does AdvancedMD have better billing than SimplePractice?
faqs.a: AdvancedMD offers full RCM services where they handle billing for 4-8% of collections. SimplePractice is self-service billing at $0.25/claim. If you want someone else to handle billing, AdvancedMD has the advantage. If you manage billing yourself, both work well.

AdvancedMD includes e-prescribing with EPCS in its bundles. SimplePractice charges $49/month extra for e-prescribing. If you prescribe heavily, AdvancedMD's inclusive pricing may be more cost-effective.

faqs.q: Can I avoid long-term contracts with AdvancedMD?
faqs.a: AdvancedMD Now (self-service at $130/month for mental health) is month-to-month with cancel anytime. Full AdvancedMD bundles typically require multi-year contracts. SimplePractice is always month-to-month.
